claims.source_quote_ar: أنه لو نقص من الأجر أدنى شيء وأصغره
claims.claim_ar: تلويح بلاغي للتأكيد بعدم وقوع ظلم «نَقِيرًا» — أي عدم المسّ بأدنى قدر من الثواب أو الجزاء (توظيف الطِباق بين العظيم والدقائق).
claims.claim_en: A rhetorical emphasis on the absence of injustice 'not even a tiny amount' — the use of contrast (tibaq) highlights that not the smallest portion of reward or punishment will be unjustly altered.
claims.needs_review_reason: The supporting source (Zamakhshari passage about مثقال ذرة and 'أدنى شيء') discusses the theological point about tiniest measures; applying it as a rhetorical identification for this word is plausible but indirect.

claims.claim_en: The phrase 'from male or female' functions as elaboration/expansion (itnaab), clarifying the inclusiveness of 'believers' — it explicates/specifies who is meant by the general term.
claims.needs_review_reason: The quoted source gives an example of explanatory gloss ('المؤمنون يعنى المؤمنين منهم') elsewhere; using it to support that the gender phrase is an explanatory expansion in this ayah is an interpretation that needs checking against direct exegetical statements on S4:124.
